resident.ownerTagline: Pay your maintenance, see notices and raise complaints
resident.tenantTagline: See your flat’s dues, notices and complaints
resident.duesSummary: See what is due and pay it by UPI in a few taps.
resident.dues1: Tap Dues in the bar at the bottom. The top card shows the total due. All pending months are selected; untick any you don’t want to pay now.
resident.dues2: Tap “Pay via UPI”. Your UPI app (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm…) opens with the society’s UPI ID and the amount filled in. Pay as usual.
resident.dues3: Back in the app, open “I’ve paid”, enter the amount and the UTR / transaction ID from your UPI app, and send it. A screenshot helps the treasurer confirm it faster.
resident.dues4: The dues show “Awaiting verification” until the treasurer confirms the money arrived. You get a receipt by email once it is confirmed.
resident.dues5: If you pay more than is due, the extra is kept as your credit and pays your next dues automatically.
resident.communitySummary: Stay informed and tell the committee about problems.
resident.community1: Notices from the committee appear on Home and under Notices. Emergency notices are marked in red.
resident.community2: Under Complaints, tap “Raise a complaint”, choose a type, describe the problem and add photos if you like. Only you and the committee can see it.
resident.community3: When the committee marks it resolved, check and tap “Yes, close it”, or reopen it if the problem is still there.
resident.community4: Community is a board for the whole society: recommendations, lost and found, events. Be kind; the committee can remove posts.
resident.languageSummary: Use the app in English, Hindi or Marathi.
resident.language1: Tap your initials at the top right and choose English, हिन्दी or मराठी. Emails from your society follow the same choice.
